antinuke.title: {emoji:shield} Anti-Nuke Control Center
antinuke.dashboard_desc: Enterprise server protection monitoring destructive actions in real-time.

mode_descriptions.hard: Strict protection against suspicious destructive server changes, applying the configured thresholds and punishments.
mode_descriptions.ultimate: Reserved for a future advanced protection system; currently unavailable.
mode_descriptions.hybrid: Reserved for a future combination of security modes; currently unavailable.

punishment_definitions.ban: Ban the attributed actor when permitted.
punishment_definitions.kick: Remove the attributed actor from the server when permitted.
punishment_definitions.timeout: Apply a supported Discord timeout to the attributed actor.
punishment_definitions.prune: Use only a clearly defined, supported member-removal action; do not silently equate pruning with banning or bulk-delete messages.
punishment_definitions.strip_roles: Remove eligible roles from the attributed actor, respecting Discord's role hierarchy and permissions.

antinuke.wizard_subtitle: Auditing role hierarchy, bot permissions, and native dangerous permissions.
antinuke.hierarchy_safe: {emoji:check} **Hierarchy Check Passed**: Bot role `{bot_role}` is positioned above monitored roles.
antinuke.hierarchy_warning:
{emoji:warning} **Role Hierarchy Warning**: Bot role `{bot_role}` (pos: {bot_pos}) is **lower** than {higher_roles_count} role(s) (`{higher_roles}`).
*Note:* The bot **cannot** restrict or protect against users in higher roles.
antinuke.bot_perms_safe: {emoji:check} **Bot Permissions Check**: Bot holds all required administrative permissions.
antinuke.bot_perms_missing: {emoji:cross} **Bot Missing Permissions**: Bot is missing: `{missing_perms}`. Grant these to enable full protection.
antinuke.dangerous_roles_clean: {emoji:check} No unmanaged roles hold dangerous administrative permissions.
antinuke.risk_administrator: • **Administrator**: Bypasses all channel overwrites and role restrictions. A rogue administrator can completely wipe the server, kick all members, and delete all webhooks.
antinuke.risk_manage_guild: • **Manage Server**: Allows altering server name, vanity URL, widget, and adding unauthorized bot integrations.
antinuke.risk_manage_roles: • **Manage Roles**: Allows creating, modifying, and deleting roles below the user's role, or granting dangerous permissions to lower roles.
antinuke.risk_manage_channels: • **Manage Channels**: Allows bulk deletion or modification of text/voice channels, causing irreversible channel loss.
antinuke.risk_ban_members: • **Ban Members**: Allows mass-banning members below the user's highest role.
antinuke.risk_kick_members: • **Kick Members**: Allows mass-expelling members below the user's highest role.
antinuke.risk_manage_webhooks: • **Manage Webhooks**: Allows generating rogue webhook tokens that bypass bot automod filters to send phishing links.
antinuke.virtualization_notice: {emoji:wrench} **Security Recommendation**: Restrict native dangerous permissions from moderators and authorize them via MomentumOne commands (`$channel`, `$announce`).
antinuke.whitelist_empty: No users or bots are whitelisted. Only the Server Owner and Extra Owners are exempt.
antinuke.extra_owner_added: {emoji:check} Added `{user_name}` (`{user_id}`) as an Anti-Nuke Extra Owner.
antinuke.extra_owner_not_found: {emoji:warning} User `{user_id}` is not in Extra Owners.
antinuke.extra_owner_empty: No Extra Owners configured. Only the Server Owner (`<@{owner_id}>`) has security management rights.
antinuke.extra_owner_only: {emoji:denied} Only the Server Owner or configured Extra Owners can access Anti-Nuke configuration.
antinuke.ticket_bot_added: {emoji:check} Approved ticket bot `{bot_name}` (`{bot_id}`). Ticket channel creation/deletion will not trigger false-positive anti-nuke bans.
antinuke.ticket_bot_empty: No ticket bots are exempted. Any bot creating/deleting channels will be monitored.
antinuke.mode_invalid: {emoji:cross} Invalid operating mode. Available modes: `hard`, `ultimate` (Ultimate Defence Wall), `hybrid`.
antinuke.threshold_updated: {emoji:check} Updated threshold for `{event}` to **{count}** actions per **{window}s**.
antinuke.warning_channel_set: {emoji:check} Security warning & alert channel set to <#{channel_id}>.
antinuke.alert_title_user: Forensic Alert: Unauthorized User Operation Blocked
antinuke.alert_title_bot: Forensic Alert: Unauthorized Bot Operation Blocked
antinuke.rec_ban: Review recent bans in server audit log and unban any legitimately banned members if necessary.
antinuke.rec_kick: Audit kick log and verify whether the executor account was compromised or token-hijacked.
antinuke.rec_bot_add: The unauthorized bot was expelled immediately. Audit who invited the bot and revoke their bot invite permissions.
antinuke.rec_role_delete: Role was deleted by attacker. Re-create the role and check role hierarchy.
antinuke.rec_role_update: Dangerous permissions were added to a role. Revert permissions and demote compromised moderators.
antinuke.rec_channel_delete: Channel was deleted. Review backups or channel audit log and ensure moderator credentials are secure.
antinuke.rec_channel_create: Mass channel creation burst detected. Delete spam channels and check moderator roles.
antinuke.rec_webhook_create: Unauthorized webhook created. Immediately delete rogue webhooks in channel settings to prevent spam/phishing.

antinuke.wizard_step2_desc:
Choose the defensive posture for {guild_name}:

• **Ultimate Defence Wall (`ultimate`):** Configurable sliding burst thresholds with automated quarantine. Recommended for active communities.
• **Hard Zero-Tolerance (`hard`):** 1 unauthorized action triggers immediate permanent ban.
• **Hybrid Dynamic Defense (`hybrid`):** Zero-tolerance instant bans on bot additions & permission escalation, sliding-window burst defense on channels/roles.
antinuke.wizard_step3_desc: Select which gateway events to monitor in real-time. By default, all 23 high and critical risk events are actively guarded against unauthorized actions.
antinuke.wizard_step4_desc:
Review default disciplinary responses:
• Critical events (bans, kicks, role deletes, bot additions): **BAN**
• High events (channels, roles, webhooks): **QUARANTINE**
• Rate-limit breaches: **TIMEOUT**
antinuke.wizard_step5_desc:
Specify where forensic alerts and security logs should be dispatched:
• **Warning Channel:** Immediate high-priority alerts with actionable remediation.
• **Log Channel:** Audit trail of all security checks and non-punitive events.
antinuke.wizard_incomplete_warning: {emoji:warning} Setup Incomplete: You must complete the setup process before anti-nuke defense can be activated.
antinuke.wizard_cancelled: {emoji:info} Anti-Nuke Setup Wizard cancelled. Existing configuration was preserved.
antinuke.wizard_wl_pick_type:
Select the entity type you wish to whitelist:

• **User:** Exempts an individual user or verified bot account.
• **Role:** Exempts all members holding a specified server role.
• **Channel:** Exempts actions occurring inside a specific text/voice channel.
• **Category:** Exempts channel actions within an entire category.
antinuke.wizard_wl_select_events: Select which events this entity is permitted to perform without triggering anti-nuke sanctions. You can choose specific events or all events.
antinuke.punishment_overview:
Configure automated punishments when an unwhitelisted entity exceeds authorized thresholds.

• **Current Operating Mode:** `{mode_name}`
• **Active Punishments Configured:** `{count}` events
antinuke.mode_disabled_notice: {emoji:warning} The mode `{mode}` is currently disabled by system feature flags. Only enabled security modes can be activated.

punishments.ban: Permanently bans the offending member from the server. Requires Ban Members permission and bot role hierarchy.
punishments.kick: Kicks the offending member from the server. Requires Kick Members permission and bot role hierarchy.
punishments.timeout: Applies an administrative timeout/mute to the offending member. Requires Moderate Members permission.
punishments.prune: Kicks unauthorized or compromised accounts from the server.
punishments.strip_roles: Immediately removes all dangerous administrative roles from the offending member within bot role hierarchy limits.
punishments.quarantine: Reserved for a future role-based containment system; currently unavailable.
